en: A multi-image winter-sport postcard with a blue border showing scenes from a large cross‑country ski race. The top-left image shows a mass start of skiers wearing numbered bibs. The top-right image shows skiers approaching a finish or checkpoint banner amid snowy forested hills. The bottom-left image shows many children and families on skis in a snowy park. The bottom-right image shows a smiling skier in race gear speaking with an older man in winter clothing near red fencing. The central caption reads "TARTU MARATON" and on the right side "WORLDLOPPET"; there are also small logos.
